## Your costumes finally get announced, and the starfield became a tunnel

**Outfits used to unlock in silence.** You'd earn one and it would just quietly appear in the picker, if you happened to go looking. Now there's a proper **OUTFIT UNLOCKED** screen: the headline lands letter by letter in a rainbow, glitching, with Squachy modelling the new costume and its name underneath.

It knows the difference between "new" and "you already had this". Upgrading onto a device that has already earned six outfits announces nothing — only what you earn from here is treated as news. And if one detection crosses two thresholds at once, you get both, one after the other, rather than one of them being swallowed.

**STARFIELD is now a tunnel.** Nested polygons scrolling outward with the warp stars still behind them, planets drifting past, and junk that arrives as an occasional event rather than a permanent crowd — one or two pieces that rush out of the vanishing point, blow up to full size and exit off the side.

Two things had to stay continuous across the scroll or the whole tube flashed once a cycle. The blue/violet alternation is a two-ring pattern, so the scroll now runs over two ring-widths — before, each wrap handed a ring's geometry to its opposite colour and inverted the entire tube. And every ring now shares one rotation instead of carrying its own twist, which was snapping at the same seam. The violet was also quantising to a dimmer *blue* rather than a second hue on this panel; it now actually reads purple.

**The ALERT screen shows your background.** Whatever you've picked runs behind the detection instead of flat black.

**AirTags announce on battery insert.** Detection now matches the Find My payload directly rather than inferring it, so a tag you've just powered up is seen straight away.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: OUTFIT UNLOCKED celebration, queued so simultaneous unlocks all get shown
- **Added**: the ALERT screen runs your selected background behind it
- **Changed**: STARFIELD rebuilt as a rotating polygon tunnel; the nebula is gone
- **Changed**: starfield junk is now rare and fast rather than constant and small
- **Fixed**: AirTags were not detected when first powered on
- **Fixed**: the tunnel inverted its colours and snapped its rotation once every cycle
